# refactor Brewfile and Apps

Decide, for applications available both as a Homebrew cask and in the Mac App Store, which channel installs them: "find apps from Brewfile, remove them and use fallback to homebrew" — keep one list, prefer the App Store where the app is there (licensing, updates via the store), and fall back to the cask otherwise. At the time [toolset/Apps](../../toolset/Apps) (mas ids) and the Brewfile overlapped for 1Password, DaisyDisk, Slack, Telegram, TickTick.
